roles.title: Financial Data Scientist
roles.description: Develop and deploy machine learning and statistical models in Python and Scikit-learn across customer, account, transaction and operational datasets of 300K+ records.
highlights: Build predictive models for customer behavior, risk, credit, fraud and retention, supporting 8+ business use cases across financial and customer analytics.
Improved selected model performance by approximately 15% through hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation and error analysis, evaluating with precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, RMSE and MAE.
Improved analytical data quality by 18% through structured preprocessing, missing-value treatment and validation during EDA and feature engineering.
Use SQL to create reusable analytical datasets and feature pipelines, reducing recurring data preparation effort by 20% across 6+ machine learning workflows.
Apply XGBoost, classification, clustering and supervised/unsupervised learning across 12+ modeling experiments using behavioral and transactional features.

roles.title: AI/ML Data Scientist
roles.description: Developed machine learning and statistical models for business, customer and operational analytics on datasets of 150K+ records across multiple analytical initiatives.
highlights: Built supervised and unsupervised models using Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, evaluating 10+ model configurations across business use cases.
Improved selected model performance by approximately 12% across iterative experiments through hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, model evaluation and error analysis.
Reduced recurring data preparation time by 15% through reusable Python and SQL workflows for cleaning, preprocessing, EDA and feature engineering.
Applied feature selection, transformation, encoding, scaling and dimensionality reduction across 20+ candidate variables to improve model inputs.
Used SQL, Python, Matplotlib and Seaborn for analytical datasets, visualizations and customer segmentation across 6+ recurring analytical workflows.
